prompts.connect: – intake: map the AUE into its elements and purpose records when you are assigned an intake
prompts.instructions: intake is active. When assigned an intake, follow the procedure at resource metaform://intake/procedure, or read it in your shell with metaform intake prompt, and record the map with the project tool.
prompts.no_intake:
FIRST RUN. Metaform has not analysed this project yet. Handle this first, even if the person asked for something else; tell them you'll get to their request right after.
1. Ask the person once, in your own words: "This is the first time Metaform is running in this project. I'd like to do a quick analysis so I understand how it fits together. You can watch it build live in a browser view on this machine. Want me to start?" 2. If they say no, drop it and help with what they asked. 3. If they say yes, do all of this in order without asking again: b. Start the browser view: run metaform web start in your shell. Give them the address. If it fails, tell them what it said and stop. c. Read the procedure: run metaform intake prompt in your shell. Start ONE fresh subagent and give it that text, exactly as written, as its task. Do not summarize or reword it, do not split the work, and do not do the analysis yourself unless you cannot start a subagent. It records the map with the project tool. d. When it finishes, tell them it's done and invite their questions.
prompts.register_step: a. Register this folder: run metaform add project <id> . in your shell, with a short name for <id>.
